concepts.title: 한 줄 입력 + split + map
concepts.summary: 공백으로 구분된 숫자는 split 후 map(int)로 변환합니다.
concepts.algorithm:
```text
1) 한 줄을 split으로 나눈다.
2) 각 토큰을 int로 변환한다.
```

concepts.title: 서식문자 출력
concepts.summary: %d 개수와 값의 개수가 정확히 맞아야 합니다.
concepts.algorithm:
```text
1) 포맷 문자열을 작성한다.
2) 대응되는 값을 튜플로 넣는다.
```

concepts.title: input과 int 변환
concepts.summary: input()은 문자열이므로 int로 변환해야 계산할 수 있습니다.

problems.title: Trace 1. Two integers in one line
problems.description:
Given the input line, split it into two values and convert them to integers.
Fill the table with input1, input2, a, b, and the final output.

Example table:
| input1 | input2 | a | b | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 0 |
problems.code:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)

problems.title: Trace 2. Two-line multiplication
problems.description:
Two lines are provided as input.
Read line1 into a, line2 into b, then compute a * b.
Fill the table step by step.

Example table:
| value | a | b | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 3 | 5 | 0 |
problems.code:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print(a * b)

problems.title: Reverse 1. Find the second input
problems.description:
You are told the first input and the final output.
Find the missing second input. (number only)
problems.code:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print(a + b)

problems.title: Trace 3. Three integers expression
problems.description:
Split the input line into a, b, c and convert to integers.
Compute a * b + c. Fill the table with variables and output.

Example table:
| a | b | c | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | 5 | 1 | 0 |
problems.code:
a, b, c = map(int, input().split())
print(a * b + c)

problems.title: Short 1. Swap output order
problems.description:
Read two values and print them in reverse order.
Write the exact output as one line.
